I am an old woman, 63 years now, and I have farmed this maize plot for many seasons. My husband is gone and I work this land with my own hands, sometimes my daughter helps me when she comes. I wait for the coupon from the government — if it comes, I get one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, and I use it on this plot because the soil here is tired. I plant the seed I keep from last year because the hybrid seed costs too much money, and I put the manure from my few chickens and goats around the maize. I plant beans and pumpkins together with my maize like my mother taught me, so even if the maize is small I have something to eat.
